offer_strategist_output.1_core_commercial_problem: Arc's procurement-facing owned pages do not present one authoritative, supportable account of company scale, client scale, certification and performance. The strongest verified issue is the conflict between published project and client figures, reinforced by important claims whose supporting detail is not visible on the sampled pages.
offer_strategist_output.2_why_the_problem_matters: A buyer using Arc's site to assess credibility may have to resolve conflicting figures and request basic substantiation before trusting the wider proposition. This creates verification friction at the point where Arc is asking for a quote. The audit did not establish lost enquiries, lost revenue or buyer rejection, so those outcomes remain unclaimed.

3_smallest_credible_entry_engagement.name: Procurement Trust Claims Reconciliation
3_smallest_credible_entry_engagement.purpose: Create one evidence-controlled source of truth and a correction specification for the highest-risk procurement-facing claims, without rebuilding the website.

4_exact_scope: Create a claims register for project count, client count, operating footprint, ISO or certification wording, and the facility-management savings, uptime and response claims.
Ask Arc to identify the authoritative value and supporting source for every conflicting or incompletely substantiated claim. Unresolved claims remain flagged and are not rewritten as fact.
Map the approved claims across four owned surfaces: homepage, mission/about page, facility-management page and contact page.
Produce a page-level correction specification covering exact claim placement, consistency, qualification language and visible substantiation requirements.
Produce one procurement-trust evidence checklist showing what may be published, what needs qualification, what needs a supporting reference and what should be withheld.
Perform a final read-only consistency review of the agreed correction specification. Website implementation is not included.
5_explicit_exclusions: No website rebuild, redesign, development, CMS mutation or publishing.
No new brand strategy, rebrand, messaging system or full-site copy rewrite.
No SEO, GEO, social, review-platform, local-search or paid-media work.
No quote-form submission, delivery test, CRM integration or workflow automation.
No certification verification, legal opinion, compliance certification or procurement assurance.
No invention or independent validation of project totals, client totals, performance results, contract value, budget, signing authority or named buyer.
No creation of new case studies or claims about clients whose relationship or outcomes have not been independently verified.
No price, timeline or staffing commitment until Emmanuel approves those commercial terms.

6_approved_findings_supporting_the_offer.finding: Owned pages publish 500+ versus 5,000+ completed projects and 20+ corporate clients versus 500+ satisfied clients.
The facility-management page publishes savings, uptime and response claims without visible methodology or independent substantiation on the sampled page.
The site states that services are ISO certified, but the sampled pages did not visibly identify the standard, certificate number, issuing body, scope or validity date.
Arc provides a viable general business destination and quote route, but no named decision maker or signing authority was established.
Client names or logos and named testimonials are visible, but their underlying relationships and results were not independently verified by the audit.
The bounded competitor sample exposes clearer combinations of company, certification, legal-identity, location and procurement-oriented trust detail.

7_proof_asset_and_fit.approved_claim: Oliviks Kitchen Foundation delivery completed and the oliviks.com cutover was verified live on 2026-07-24.
7_proof_asset_and_fit.fit: It is registered as strong proof for Digital Platforms & Brand Systems and supports BridgeWorks delivery credibility for a bounded website trust and lead-path engagement.
7_proof_asset_and_fit.usage_boundary: Foundation scope only. It does not prove Arc's diagnosis, promise Arc a commercial result or imply an ongoing Oliviks retainer.

8_likely_buyer_contact_route.buyer_role_hypothesis: The internal owner of Arc's commercial, corporate communications or website claims should sponsor the evidence decisions.
8_likely_buyer_contact_route.viable_route: Arc's published general business contact destination or quote route.

9_unresolved_uncertainty: Which published project and client figures are authoritative.
Whether the ISO claim is current and the applicable standard, issuer, scope and validity.
What evidence supports the published savings, uptime and response claims.
Who owns the relevant claims internally and who has signing authority.
Whether the observed inconsistencies affect enquiry conversion or procurement decisions.
Price, delivery timeline, staffing and Arc's willingness to provide source evidence are unresolved.
10_offer_invalidators_or_weakeners: Fresh evidence shows the conflicting figures are intentionally scoped and already clearly distinguished for users.
Arc can produce a current authoritative claims register and substantiation that is already applied consistently across the four surfaces.
The general contact route cannot reach the owner of the claims or no internal owner will validate them.
Arc will not provide source evidence for the claims or approve removal or qualification of unsupported wording.
A higher-priority verified problem emerges that makes claims reconciliation commercially immaterial.
The Oliviks proof cannot be used within its registered Foundation-only boundary.
offer_strategist_output.11_recommended_commercial_framing: Frame this as a Procurement Trust Claims Reconciliation: make the most important public proof claims consistent, traceable and easier for a serious buyer to verify before requesting a quote. Do not frame it as a website rebuild, a generic audit, or a promise to increase conversion.
offer_strategist_output.12_exact_next_action: Emmanuel or the GTM Director reviews this bounded decision and either accepts, revises or rejects the proposed engagement. If accepted, persist a separate offer_selected transition receipt with the approved scope boundary before any outreach preparation.
